dialAngle.description: Minutes past midnight → radians, midnight at the top, clockwise.

dialPoint.description: Point at radius r for a minute-of-day; y grows downward (SVG / UIKit).

dialArcPath.description: Stroke-only arc path; largeArc flips past half a revolution. `numbers` is every numeric token of `d` in order.

dialSectorPath.description: Closed annular sector: outer arc clockwise, inner arc back counter-clockwise.

dialTicks.description: The bezel schedule: a tick every 5 minutes, classified hour / quarter / minor.

dialIntensity.description: Opacity and edge weight by block duration; saturates at 180 minutes.

padDialSegment.description: Inter-block breathing room; the pad yields on slivers and a flagged side stays flush.

dialLaneBand.description: Radial band of one lane inside the ring; DIAL_LANE_GAP is 6.

assignDialLanes.description: Concentric lane packing for overlapping blocks (startMin-sorted input).

computeDialModel.description: Tasks + day window → ring blocks (with energy kind, lanes, midnight clipping), all-day items, sleep segments and totals.

cases.name: categorised, sorted, all-day and unscheduled left off the ring
imported calendar events are not completable
clipped at midnight, true end kept
last night's overrun carried into this morning
carried block laned against the morning
no sleep without a full window

computeDialRoutines.description: Routines → bars on the outer track; all-day and zero-length routines are skipped.

muteDialColor.description: Any task colour → the dial's pastel-emissive family; greys collapse to one neutral; junk falls back.

moonPhasePath.description: Lit portion of a moon disc as a path; `terminatorRx` is the second arc's x-radius, the whole shape in one number.

findDialFocusBlock.description: The running block at nowMin, or the next one up, with the phase the hub speaks.

dialSelection.description: Keyboard-walk entry point and stepping; included because a port with a focus ring needs the same order.

getSunTimes.description: Rise/set in local clock minutes; polar days carry a flag and null minutes.

computeSkySnapshot.description: What the widget snapshot ships under `sky`: 24 hourly sun/moon strengths, rise/set, moon phase and glyph minute.

computeDaylightBand.description: The in-app daylight band at 4-minute steps (no UV scaling); the hourly `sky.hours[].sun` is this, sampled.

computeMoonBand.description: The in-app moon band, clipped to the hours the sun is down; `sky.hours[].moon` is this, sampled.

projectDialSnapshot.description: The `dial` field of the widget snapshot: every timed block of the day, typed, start-sorted, drawn spans clipped at midnight.
